==Notes==
*This skill will remain on an ally even if all enchantments end or are removed, but the speed boost will be lost until another enchantment is applied.
*This skill increases average speed by '''<font color=green>4.17...14.17...16.67%</font>''' if used every time it recharges and ally/allies is/are enchanted for the full duration of Godspeed. 
* If the team members do not already use their own enchantments, one can use the following options to enchant and get the speed boost on as many of them as possible:
** Party wide enchantments spells: [[Aegis]], [[Dwayna's Sorrow]], [[Magnetic Surge]], [[Swirling Aura]], [[Magnetic Aura]] (all three if overcast) and [[order]] spells. 
*** [[Dwayna's Sorrow]] is the only one to combine both perfect upkeep and long lasting duration. It is also notably cheap with a short casting time.
** [[Spam]]mable long-lasting enchantments: [[Tainted Flesh]] or [[Vigorous Spirit]] mostly. 
** [[Upkeep|Maintained enchantment]]s.
